theater: 劍南西川越巂會同定莋邊地

battle.name: 劍南、西川之戰
battle.theater: 劍南西川越巂會同定莋邊地
battle.brief: 大曆十四年（779）末，劍南西川節度使張虔陀杖殺南詔使者，閣羅鳳發兵反攻，攻下嶍州（越巂）、會同、定莋一線城邑，虔陀死於軍中；兩國自此在嶍姚地界僵持二十二年，至貞元十八年唐軍追擊大敗南詔軍，議和收場。卡面的埃及長矛早此役數千年，不會出現在嶍州城下，但它代表的密集列陣長矛，正是這場邊爭中雙方步兵的骨幹。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 大曆十四年（779）末，劍南道與南詔在嶍、姚一線的邊境上正面碰撞，交戰雙方是唐朝劍南西川節度使幕府與南詔王國。劍南道自上元元年（757）析置東西川兩軍，西川節度使治成都，節度使一身兼軍、政、財三權，募兵自給、就地屯糧，跨鎮調兵須由中書省下詔，各鎮兵權實際分散在西川、東川以及劍南以外的諸道之間。南詔一方自開元二十六年（738）皮羅閣兼並六詔、定都太和城之後，國勢沿洱海向西北推進，名義上奉唐朝冊封為雲南王，實際上已把嶍州（越巂）、姚州一帶的舊地視為勢力範圍。唐廷則把嶍州劃入劍南道版圖，在州境內修築定莋城，任用會同、定莋等縣的邊吏，並以嶍州為卡住南詔北上的支點。兩邊在這條線上相持數十年，邊軍的守備重點是邛州、雅州、茂州一路的山道與渡口，糧秣由成都沿官道北出，再轉山道運往大渡河上游的邊城。同一時期唐廷忙於削藩與對付吐蕃，劍南拿不出遠征之兵，這一點決定了邊界上每一次衝突都會變成長期的拉鋸。
countriesEn: At the end of 779 CE, on the frontier where the Jiannan circuit met the lands of Nanzhao around the districts of Yue and Yao, the forces of the Tang jiedushi of Xichuan and the Nanzhao kingdom came into direct collision. The Jiannan circuit had been split into two commands in 757, the first year of the Shangyuan era, with the Xichuan jiedushi seated at Chengdu; the jiedushi held military, civil and financial authority in a single person, recruited and paid his own soldiers, and grew grain where he stood, and any transfer of troops between commands had to be ordered by the Secretariat, so that in practice the armed strength was divided among Xichuan, Dongchuan and the many other circuits. On the Nanzhao side, since the Open Origin era (738), when Piluoge had absorbed the six zhao and made Taihe city his capital, the kingdom had been pushing north-westward from Lake Erhai; it nominally accepted a Tang investiture as King of Yunnan, but in practice already treated the old lands of Xuezhou, or Yuexi, and Yao prefecture as within its sphere of interest. The Tang court, for its part, drew Xuezhou into the map of the Jiannan circuit, built the fortified town of Dingzhuo inside the prefecture, appointed frontier officials to counties such as Huitong and Dingzhuo, and used Xuezhou as the pivot that held Nanzhao back from the north. The two sides had tugged at this line for decades; the defence of the border garrison rested on the mountain tracks and fords of the Qinzhou, Yazhou and Maozhou line, and grain left Chengdu along the official road to the north before being carried onto mountain paths to the frontier towns above the Dadu River. At the same time the court was absorbed in reducing the regional governors and in fighting Tibet, and Jiannan could never find troops for a campaign inland, which is why every clash on this frontier turned into a long pull rather than a decision.
people: 這場邊爭留下的人名不算多，但幾個位置都相當清楚。南詔王閣羅鳳是開元末至建中初年的在位者，他在位期間把南詔從洱海一隅推到嶍、姚地界，也是他決定在使者被殺之後用兵回應。劍南西川節度使張虔陀是這場衝突的直接觸發者，他久鎮成都，行事嚴苛而貪暴，接待南詔使者時凌辱備至，終至使者被杖殺於軍中；隨後南詔出兵反攻，虔陀兵敗，據編年記載他死於軍中，具體死因與經過各書說法不一。此人死後，西川軍府數度更換主將，邊界陷入沒有大戰、也沒有議和的僵局，直到貞元元年（785）韋皋出任劍南西川節度使才換了一種做法：韋皋以招撫為主，恢復馬市、往來使者，兩國邊界一度平順；至貞元十七年（801）南詔再啟兵端，韋皋全力反擊，貞元十九年（803）雙方議和，交換俘虜，唐朝重新冊封閣羅鳳為雲南王，而韋皋自此鎮蜀近四十年。另有一個可以對照的前人：天寶十三載（754）劍南節度使鮮于仲通南征，在大和城一役中覆師，那次敗仗留下的虧空，正是二十五年後劍南邊軍在體量與士氣上偏低的原因。
peopleEn: Few personal names survive from this frontier war, but several of them are firmly placed. Geluofeng, king of Nanzhao, reigned from the end of the Kaiyuan era into the early Jianzhong years; during his reign he pushed the kingdom from a corner of Lake Erhai up to the Yue and Yao borderlands, and it was he who chose to answer with arms once the envoy had been killed. The jiedushi of Xichuan, Zhang Qiantuo, was the direct occasion of the clash: he had held Chengdu for years, governed harshly and greedily, and when the Nanzhao envoys arrived he humiliated them without measure until the envoys were beaten to death in the military camp. Nanzhao then marched in reprisal, Zhang was beaten, and the chronicles record that he died in the camp, though the accounts differ over the manner and the sequence. After his death the Xichuan command changed hands several times, and the frontier fell into a stalemate of neither battles nor treaties, until Wei Gao took up the post of jiedushi of Xichuan in the first year of Zhengyuan (785) and changed the method: he worked mainly through conciliation, reopened the horse markets and the passage of envoys, and for a time the border of the two states was quiet; in the seventeenth year of Zhengyuan (801) Nanzhao opened hostilities again, Wei Gao answered in force, and in the nineteenth year of Zhengyuan (803) the two sides made peace, exchanged prisoners, and the Tang court invested Geluofeng as King of Yunnan once more, while Wei Gao went on to hold Sichuan for nearly forty years. One earlier figure serves as a foil: in the thirteenth year of Tianbao (754) the jiedushi of Jiannan, Xianyu Zhongtong, campaigned south and was wiped out at the battle of Dahecheng, and the hole that defeat left is precisely why the Jiannan border troops of 779 were thin in numbers and low in spirit.
kits: 卡面上的埃及長矛屬於早王朝時期的埃及：銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，形制簡單，卻是當時最可靠的冷兵器，埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。它不會出現在七七九年的嶍州城下，因為那已是數千年之後，兵器本身早已改用鐵質矛頭、槊與各式金屬裝飾；它真正能對上的位置在體系上，而不在現場。查諸唐與南詔的裝備：唐代邊軍以募兵為主，府兵制早已罷廢，步兵的核心裝備是長矛與短槊，輔以皮甲、札甲與少量明光鎧，射手用弓與弩，並攜橫刀與長劍；南詔軍隊以洱海流域抽丁而成，步兵以持矛結陣見長，騎兵精於山道奔馳，攻城時用雲梯、撞槌與飛石，與唐軍在大和城使用的器械同屬一類。糧秣與運輸方面，唐軍靠成都、邛州、雅州的分段屯糧與牛車轉運，軍馬多自隴右、河西與互市取得；南詔則靠洱海周邊的倉廩與蜀地商路維持。這一戰裡真正決定勝負的既不是箭矢射程，也不是鐵甲厚薄，而是兩軍能否把長矛手排成能承受衝鋒的密集隊形，並在正確的時間把糧草送到前線。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the early dynastic period of Egypt: a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, a simple form and yet the most reliable cold weapon of its day, used by the Egyptians to hold city walls and later to recover lost ground. It would not be found beneath the walls of Xuezhou in 779, for that was several millennia later and the weapon itself had long since moved to iron heads, to the sao and to a range of metal fittings; the place where it does correspond is structural rather than actual. Taking the armament of the Tang and of Nanzhao in order: the Tang border force was recruited, the fubing system having long since been abandoned, and the core equipment of its foot was the long spear and the short sao, supported by leather and lamellar armour with a little Ming guang mail, while its archers used bows and crossbows and carried cross-sabres and long swords. The Nanzhao army was levied from the districts around Lake Erhai; its infantry were noted for closing up in ordered ranks with spears in hand, its cavalry were skilled at riding over mountain tracks, and at sieges it used scaling ladders, rams and stone-throwers, all of them machines of the same family as those the Tang had employed at Dahecheng. As for supply and transport, the Tang depended on segmented depots at Chengdu, Qinzhou and Yazhou and on ox-drawn wagons, taking remounts chiefly from Longyou, Hexi and the frontier markets, while Nanzhao drew on the granaries around Erhai and on the trade roads of Shu. What in fact decided this war was neither the range of the arrows nor the thickness of the iron, but whether each side could close its spear into the dense ranks that would absorb a charge, and could bring grain to the line at the right moment.
tactics: 南詔在嶍、姚邊地的打法，與其後在成都平原上的打法是同一套邏輯：以步兵持矛結陣作前鋒，盾與矛交替遮蔽，緩緩推向城垣，掩護身後的雲梯與撞槌；騎兵不與步兵同行，而是沿山脊迂迴，切斷唐軍的糧道與援兵道路。嶍州治所在大渡河支流西河上游的高山谷地，城池依山而建，坡度大、通道窄，攻方要把攻城器械運上坡地，雲梯一旦被守方以長杆推倒便難以再用，因此南詔的攻城多半不是一次完成，而是反覆試探、破一處、駐紮、添丁，再轉向下一處。唐軍的守禦則以城為依托，閉門拒守，在城門與登城梯道之間列長矛拒馬，並以弓弩覆蓋城下，減少守軍出城與南詔接戰的機會；真正困擾唐廷的不是一時的城池得失，而是嶍、姚失守之後成都方向少了一道緩衝，邊軍必須把防線壓到邛州、雅州一線，後勤線因此拉長。至於八百零二年韋皋的反擊，則不急於攻城，而是先斷糧道，再於導江、清溪一線追上南詔回撤的部隊，把一場邊境衝突變成一場追擊戰，勝負在奔跑與斷糧中決定，而不是在城牆上。
tacticsEn: The way Nanzhao fought along the Yue and Yao border was the same logic it would later use on the Chengdu plain: foot soldiers with spears closed into ranks at the head of the column, shields and spears covering each other in turn as they pressed slowly on to the walls, screening the scaling ladders and rams that followed behind; the cavalry did not march with the infantry at all but swung round the ridges to cut the Tang supply line and the road by which relief would come. The seat of Xuezhou lay in the high valleys of the upper Xi River, a tributary of the Dadu, where the towns were built against the slope with steep gradients and narrow approaches. The besiefer had to haul his engines up those slopes, and a scaling ladder pushed over by the defenders with a long pole was hard to use again, so the Nanzhao sieges were rarely completed in one attempt: they probed, took one position, garrisoned it, brought up more men, and then turned to the next. The Tang defence was built on the town: gates shut, the crossing of the ladders covered by rows of spears and caltrops, bows and crossbows sweeping the ground below, and as little as possible of the garrison allowed to meet the Nanzhao outside the walls. What truly troubled the court was not the temporary loss of towns but the fact that once Yue and Yao were gone there was no longer a buffer in front of Chengdu, so the line had to be pushed back to Qinzhou and Yazhou and the supply route lengthened accordingly. Wei Gao's counterstroke of 802 was in no hurry to take towns: he cut the supply road first, then caught the withdrawing Nanzhao columns on the line of Daojiang and Qingxi, turning a border clash into a pursuit, so that the result was settled by marching and by hunger rather than on a rampart.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但都指向同一個結論。第一是年表：大曆十四年（779）為唐德宗即位之年，衝突發生在該年年末，具體月日各書不載，只能按年置於歲末；張虔陀死後的僵持延續到貞元元年（785）韋皋到任，前後六年，再延續到貞元十七年（801）南詔大舉進攻與貞元十九年（803）議和，前後合計二十二年。第二是距離：西川治所成都至嶍州治越巂（今四川涼山彝族自治州越西縣）沿山道約三百公里，軍隊行軍需十數日；成都至邛州約七十公里，邛州至越西約二百五十公里，這條線既是唐軍的糧道，也是南詔反攻的軸線。嶍州城海拔逾一千五百米，四季多霧，冬季積雪，攻城器械的運送與守軍的補給都受山道所限。第三是兵力與損失：七五四年天寶十三載，劍南節度使鮮于仲通南征南詔，敗於大和城，士卒死者六萬餘人，此數見於《舊唐書》，劍南元氣自此大損；八零二年唐軍追擊之役，編年記斬獲甚眾、南詔被俘者數千、兩軍死傷以萬計。第四是編制：劍南道領十餘州，西川節度使兼領其中數州，邊軍以募兵與團練為主，兵源本地化而裝備自給。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but all of them point the same way. First the chronology: the Dali fourteenth year, 779, was the year Tang Dezong came to the throne, and the clash broke out at the end of that year; the exact month and day are not recorded in the histories, so it can only be placed at the close of the year. The stalemate that followed the death of Zhang Qiantuo ran until Wei Gao took office in the first year of Zhengyuan, 785, six years later, and on to the great Nanzhao offensive of the seventeenth year of Zhengyuan, 801 and the peace of the nineteenth, 803, giving twenty-two years in all. Second the distances: from the seat of Xichuan at Chengdu to the seat of Xuezhou at Yuexi, in today's Yuexi county of the Liangshan Yi autonomous prefecture in Sichuan, is about three hundred kilometres by the mountain road, a march of more than ten days; Chengdu to Qinzhou is about seventy kilometres, and Qinzhou to Yuexi about two hundred and fifty, and this line was both the Tang grain road and the axis of the Nanzhao counterattack. The town of Xuezhou stands above fifteen hundred metres, veiled in fog for much of the year and under snow in winter, and both the hauling of siege engines and the feeding of the garrison were governed by what the tracks would bear. Third, strength and losses: in the thirteenth year of Tianbao, 754, the jiedushi of Jiannan, Xianyu Zhongtong, campaigned south against Nanzhao and was broken at Dahecheng, the old books recording more than sixty thousand of his soldiers dead, a figure preserved in the Jiu Tang Shu; the strength of Jiannan was never recovered after that, and in the pursuit of 802 the chronicles record heavy slaughter on both sides, with several thousand Nanzhao taken prisoner. Fourth, organisation: the Jiannan circuit governed more than ten prefectures, the Xichuan jiedushi holding several of them in his own charge, and the border troops were recruited levies and local militia, locally raised and largely self-equipped.
cause: 這場衝突的起因，落在三層互相纏繞的理由上。最直接的一層是嶍、姚的歸屬：南詔兼併六詔之後，把嶍州、姚州等洱海上游的舊地視為自己的勢力，而唐廷自開元末年起把嶍州劃入劍南道、築定莋城以拒之，雙方對這條線的主張從未真正談妥，南詔屢次遣使交涉，得到的往往不是協議而是拖延。第二層是邊吏的作風：唐廷以節度使鎮守劍南，募兵自給、財權自便，邊吏為求財貨與政績，對南詔商旅與使臣多所留難、勒索、凌辱；張虔陀任內這一套作風走到極處，使者被杖殺於成都，導火線由此點燃。第三層是實力與地勢：七五四年南征的慘敗，使劍南對南詔的地理與軍力都失去信心，唐廷無力再深入洱海；南詔則剛完成六詔整合，兵精糧足，又佔高原，主動權在握。同一時候唐廷正忙著削藩、對抗吐蕃，劍南得不到支援，節度使的自主權因此更大，邊地衝突一旦發生便很難由中央收拾。
causeEn: The outbreak rested on three tangled reasons. The most immediate was the ownership of Yue and Yao: once Nanzhao had absorbed the six zhao it held the old lands above Lake Erhai, including Xuezhou and Yao prefecture, to be within its own sphere, whereas the Tang court, from the end of the Kaiyuan era, had drawn Xuezhou into the Jiannan circuit and built the fort of Dingzhuo to shut it out. The two claims over that line were never genuinely settled; the envoys Nanzhao sent to argue it returned not with a treaty but with delay. The second reason was the conduct of the frontier officials. The court garrisoned Jiannan through jiedushi who recruited their own men and handled their own money, and border officials seeking revenue and credit were given to detaining, extorting and humiliating Nanzhao traders and envoys. Under Zhang Qiantuo that practice reached its extreme and the envoys were beaten to death at Chengdu, and there the fuse was lit. The third was the balance of strength and of ground: the disaster of the campaign of 754 left Jiannan mistrusting its own knowledge of Nanzhao and its own fighting power, and the court could not march again into the Erhai region, while Nanzhao, having just completed the union of the six zhao, had disciplined troops, full granaries and the high ground on its side, and so held the initiative. At the same moment the court was busy reducing the regional governors and fighting Tibet; Jiannan received no help, the autonomy of its jiedushi grew accordingly, and once a border clash began there was no one at the centre able to settle it.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響，遠遠超過一場邊境衝突的分量。第一，疆界線就此固定下來：嶍州、姚州最終歸南詔，唐朝改在內地另置羈縻州，兩國以大渡河上游與金沙江一線的分水嶺為大致界線，直到晚唐南詔再度北進，劍南才重新陷入兵禍。第二，節度使的權力再膨脹：韋皋以招撫起家、以討伐收場，鎮蜀近四十年，其間修路、築城、練兵、開馬市、招攬人才，把劍南經營成唐末最有實力的邊鎮之一，也讓西川節度使的自主性進一步壓過中央的調度。第三，戰術取向被重新校正：唐軍在這二十二年裡試過正面攻城、屯田固守，最後有效的卻是斷糧道加追擊戰；南詔則證明在高山峽谷裡，攻城器械的作用遠不如控制交通線與糧源。第四，兵器史上的位置更值得留意：這場邊爭沒有改變冷兵器的基本分工，長矛仍是步兵骨幹，騎兵仍靠速度與衝擊，攻城仍靠雲梯與撞槌，勝負仍然取決於誰能在正確的季節、正確的位置把兵送到。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond the weight of a border skirmish. First, the frontier line was fixed: Xuezhou and Yao prefecture went finally to Nanzhao, the Tang established a jibushi prefecture in the interior in their place, and the two states took the watershed between the upper Dadu and the Jinsha as a rough boundary, which held until Nanzhao marched north again in the late Tang and Jiannan was thrown back into warfare. Second, the power of the jiedushi swelled once more. Wei Gao began by conciliation and ended with campaigns, and for nearly forty years as governor of Shu he repaired roads, raised walls, drilled troops, opened horse markets and drew able men to the province, turning Jiannan into one of the strongest border commands of the late Tang and pushing the autonomy of the Xichuan jiedushi further beyond the reach of central direction. Third, the direction of tactics was corrected: over twenty-two years the Tang tried frontal siege and garrison farming, and what finally worked was to cut the supply road and then pursue; Nanzhao showed that in high mountain gorges the engines of siege count for much less than the control of roads and of grain. Fourth, the place of this war in the history of arms is worth marking: it changed none of the basic division of labour of cold weapons. The long spear remained the backbone of the infantry, cavalry still won by speed and impact, sieges still turned on ladders and rams, and the result still depended on who could bring his men to the right place in the right season.
result: 就七七九年的那一段而言，結果是雙方的意圖都沒有完全實現。南詔以杖殺為由出兵，攻下了越巂一帶的城邑與戍所，卻沒能把唐軍從劍南逐出；唐廷失去了嶍、姚一線的緩衝，張虔陀死於軍中，邊界退到邛州、雅州一線，此後六年既不能收復失地，也不敢進攻。真正的收束發生在八百零三年：韋皋在八零二年於導江、清溪一線追上南詔回撤之軍，斬獲甚眾、俘虜數千，南詔勢力退回大渡河以南；次年雙方議和，交換俘虜，南詔歸還所擄唐軍將士，唐朝重新冊封閣羅鳳為雲南王，兩國從邊界上的武力角力回到互市與冊封的秩序裡。二十二年的邊爭，最終沒有改變南詔的獨立地位，只把唐朝在劍南的防線往北推了幾十里，也把一個節度使能自己做主的時代又往前推了一步。裝備層面的結論則樸素得近乎冷酷：這場戰爭沒有靠任何一件奇特的兵器取勝，最後決定嶍州歸屬的，是一批長矛手、一條糧道和一次追擊。
resultEn: As for the year 779 itself, the result was that neither side achieved all it wanted. Nanzhao marched out on the strength of the beating death of its envoys, took the towns and garrison posts of the Yuexi area, and yet failed to drive the Tang out of Jiannan. The Tang court lost the buffer of Yue and Yao, Zhang Qiantuo died in the camp, the frontier fell back to the Qinzhou and Yazhou line, and for the next six years it could neither recover the lost ground nor risk an advance. The real closure came in 803: in 802 Wei Gao caught the withdrawing Nanzhao army on the line of Daojiang and Qingxi, with heavy slaughter and several thousand prisoners, and Nanzhao's strength drew back below the Dadu River; the following year the two sides made peace and exchanged prisoners, Nanzhao returned the Tang soldiers it had captured, the Tang court invested Geluofeng as King of Yunnan once more, and the two countries returned from the armed contest at the border to an order of trade and investiture. Twenty-two years of border war did not change Nanzhao's independent position; they pushed the Tang line in Jiannan north by a few tens of li and moved forward again the age in which a jiedushi could decide for himself. The conclusion at the level of equipment is plain to the point of bluntness: this war was not won by any peculiar weapon, and what finally settled the ownership of Xuezhou was a body of spearmen, a supply road and a pursuit.
